item.title: Kukke Subramanya Temple - Mysteries & Secrets of Snake Worship | Temple Girl
item.description:
Why would a powerful serpent king fear for his life—and how did his search for protection become the story of Kukke Subramanya?
At Kukke Subramanya Temple in Karnataka, devotees worship God Subramanya alongside Vasuki and Adishesha. But why are these serpent kings worshipped here? What connects Garuda, God Shiva and Subramanya to this sacred place? And how does that story connect with the rituals devotees perform today?
Join Namratha in this English episode of Temple Girl as we explore Kukke’s sacred stories, the meaning behind snake worship, and what you should know before visiting.
We begin with Kadru and Vinata’s wager in the Mahabharata, Garuda’s quest to free his mother, and the enmity between Garuda and the Nagas. From there, we follow Vasuki to the Biladwara cave, his prayers to God Shiva, and Subramanya Swamy’s promise of protection.
We also explore the arrangement of Subramanya, Vasuki and Adishesha inside the sanctum, the anthill worship at Adi Subramanya, the tradition of Samputa Narasimha, and the question raised by the Garuda Stambha: why does a place associated with Vasuki’s protection have a pillar named after Garuda?
Planning a visit? This episode explains the differences between Sarpa Samskara, Ashlesha Bali and Naga Pratishta, along with Prarthana Seva and regular darshan. We discuss why Sarpa Samskara takes two days, what “bali” means in Ashlesha Bali, and why you do not need a particular dosha to visit Swamy.
Finally, discover the celebrations of Champa Shashti, the significance of the Kumaradhara river, and practical points to keep in mind for your pilgrimage.

అన్ని రకాల గ్యాస్ట్రో, బేరియాట్రిక్ సర్జరీ, లాపరోస్కోపీ సమస్యలకి చికిత్స అందిస్తూ దక్షిణ భారతదేశంలోనే నెలకు అత్యధిక బేరియాట్రిక్ సర్జరీలు చేస్తు గొప్ప ఫలితాలు సాదించారు. అంతేగాక 200 నుండి 250 కిలోల కంటే ఎక్కువ బరువున్న అత్యంత ప్రమాదకర బేరియాట్రిక్ సమస్యకి శస్త్రచికిత్స చేసి అసాధ్యాన్ని సుసాధ్యం చేసారు. సుమారు 200 కిలోల కంటే ఎక్కువ బరువున్న సూపర్ ఒబేసిటీ పేషెంట్లు మంచి ఫలితాలని పొందారు.

item.title: World War II with Tom Hanks
item.description:
A new show has been added to showRSS: World War II with Tom Hanks.

For eighty years, the Second World War has remained the most devastating and defining conflict in human history. World War II with Tom Hanks is a landmark documentary event that reexamines the war through the lens of a new century. Told over twenty hours and guided by Tom Hanks, whose lifelong passion for this history has shaped some of the most profound screen portrayals of the era, the series captures the full arc of the war — from the rise of fascism in Europe to the fall of Berlin, from Pearl Harbor to Hiroshima, and the uneasy peace that follows. Each episode uncovers new dimensions of the conflict: the decisions that shaped the battlefield, the unseen networks that sustained the war effort, and the aftershocks that still shape our world today. "World War II with Tom Hanks" is the definitive retelling of that story for a new generation: a sweeping, deeply human portrait of how the modern world was forged in the fires of global war.

item.title: The Ghost in the Shell
item.description:
A new show has been added to showRSS: The Ghost in the Shell.

Deep into the twenty-first century, the line between man and machine has been inexorably blurred as humans rely on the enhancement of mechanical implants and robots are upgraded with human tissue. In this rapidly converging landscape, cyborg superagent Major Motoko Kusanagi is charged to track down the craftiest and most dangerous terrorists and cybercriminals, including "ghost hackers" who are capable of exploiting the human/machine interface and reprogramming humans to become puppets to carry out the hackers' criminal ends. When Major Kusanagi tracks the cybertrail of one such master hacker, the Puppeteer, her quest leads her into a world beyond information and technology where the very nature of consciousness and the human soul are turned upside down.
